name: io.github.jaydip187/mcp-forge
title: mcp-forge
description: Turn HTTP/GraphQL APIs and SQL/NoSQL databases into curated MCP tools. Read-only by default.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Volume holding the projects and tools you made in the mcp-forge web UI (docker run ... ghcr.io/jaydip187/mcp-forge serve).

packageArguments.name: --project
packageArguments.description: Slug of the mcp-forge project whose tools to serve, as shown in the web UI.
